newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE wheat little changed, despite US rises.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE wheat little changed, despite US rises.

text.p: LIFFE wheat confounded traders' expectations of a US led rise by staying at or close to unchanged, traders said.
A lack of interest from shippers meant that London could not keep the momentum going. "Business just dried up," one said.
A sharp rise in US markets, triggered by weather concerns, was not enough to bring buyers into the market, he said.
Active July last traded unchanged at 101.60 stg. July volume was 172 of a total 525 lots.
A high proportion of May/July spreads means this lacklustre volume is even less exciting than it seems, traders said.
"The U.S. was high so we were looking for it to go better," the trader said. "But the fob market held it back."
A firmer sterling in the afternoon triggered some activity at around unchanged, he said.
Just nine lots of barley were traded, five of them on May, which last traded 0.75 stg down at 91.50 stg.
